style: Use case: game UI concept art for Xóm Đảo, a cozy Vietnamese island game hub for mobile web. Finished in-game screenshot, landscape phone, target 2340x1080, edge-to-edge game pixels, no phone frame, no poster, no marketing title. Art: flat cartoon 2.5D mobile game art, clean color blocks, soft outlines, simple cel shading, minimal texture, bright daylight from the upper left. Palette: turquoise sea #3EC1C9, warm sand #F3DDB0, bamboo green #6DB34A, terracotta roofs #D3603F, cream #FFF6E3, honey wood #D9963F, lantern red #E0352B, brass gold #E7B53C. World flavor: Vietnamese coastal village toys: bamboo, rope, basket boats, terracotta roofs, paper lanterns. Typography: rounded bold display font for titles and numbers, clean sans for small text, exact Vietnamese diacritics. HUD is thin and sits in the corners only, never a full-width bar.

assets.in-game-hud: In a match of Tiến Lên (Vietnamese card game) for 4 players, same art style and detail level as a polished mobile card game. A woven bamboo mat (chiếu cói) table on a wooden deck by the sea covers almost the whole screen. Middle: cards just played. Bottom band: the local player's hand of 13 fanned playing cards, card height about a quarter of the screen, two cards lifted. Bottom-right beside the hand: a glossy red lacquer button with a brass-gold border 'Đánh' and a slate blue-grey (#4E5D6C) button 'Bỏ lượt', both with cream text. Three opponents at left, top and right: each a round portrait avatar in a bamboo ring, a name 'Lan', 'Tú', 'Hải' on a small dark translucent brown pill, and next to it a separate small chip with the card count; the opponent on turn has a glowing brass-gold timer arc around the avatar. The only frame HUD: one small round dark button with a cream ☰ icon in the top-left corner. No back arrow, no gear, no speaker, no game title, no balance. All HUD and buttons sit on dark backgrounds with cream text. Text never joins parts with dots, slashes or bars; parts are separated by space, color and small chips. Rising numbers are green, falling numbers red.
assets.match-result: End-of-match results over a softly blurred card table by the sea. A centered panel with a header, body and footer: header is a honey-wood strip with rope ties and the title 'Thắng rồi!' in rounded extra-bold cream letters with a few paper confetti; body is a cream giấy dó paper inset listing 4 players in rows separated by thin decorative wave lines, each row a rank number, a round portrait avatar in a bamboo ring, a name and a coin delta on the right: '1 Minh' with a small gold crown and green '+120', '2 Lan' green '+40', '3 Tú' green '+10', '4 Hải' red '−20'. Several brass square-hole coins fly in an arc toward a small dark pill at the top-right showing a coin and '2.570'. Footer: a slate blue-grey button 'Về sảnh' and a red lacquer button with brass border 'Chơi tiếp', cream text. Nothing else on screen. All HUD and buttons sit on dark backgrounds with cream text. Text never joins parts with dots, slashes or bars; parts are separated by space, color and small chips. Rising numbers are green, falling numbers red.
assets.home-profile: Inside the player's cozy home 'Nhà', a warm wooden interior with a window to the sea and hanging plants. On the left, a large paper-on-wood profile card: big round avatar in a bamboo ring, name 'Minh', level badge '12' with a short progress bar, three small stat chips '128 ván', '64 thắng', '9 thành tích'. On the right, wooden shelves acting as an inventory grid of 12 cubbies holding collectible items: decorated card backs, avatar frames of bamboo, lotus and dragon, a red lantern, a little boat, a few empty cubbies. Above the shelves, physical bookmark-like wooden tabs 'Túi đồ', 'Thành tích', 'Xếp hạng' with 'Túi đồ' active. Top-left corner a round wooden back-arrow button. Top-right the xu plaque '2.450' and gear button.
assets.event-island: A limited-time festival event. The Trung Thu (mid-autumn) event island fills the left half at dusk: lantern-lit stilt houses, a big glowing star lantern, a full moon low over the sea, tiny villagers releasing floating lanterns on the water. On the right a festive event signboard panel in deep red lacquer and gold trim with a cream paper inset: title 'Lễ hội Trung Thu', a small hourglass and 'Còn 5 ngày', a horizontal reward track of 5 stages with lantern icons, the first two checked, items shown as small icons (xu coins, a moon cake, a lantern avatar frame, a rabbit card back, a star lantern), a large lacquered gold button 'Tham gia'. Top-left a round wooden back-arrow button, top-right xu plaque and gear button.
assets.ui-kit: A UI kit sheet for this game on a flat cream background in a tidy grid with small dark brown labels, drawn at real size ratio for a 720-unit-high screen: the big CHƠI button (glossy red lacquer, brass-gold border, cream text) in normal, pressed and disabled states; one row of action buttons all with cream text, each color meaning a kind of action: red lacquer 'Đánh', deep teal 'Tạo phòng', bamboo green 'Nhận thưởng', slate blue-grey 'Bỏ lượt', dark wood 'Luật', near-black brown with a red border 'Đầu hàng'; five round dark icon buttons with flat cream glyphs (menu, back arrow, gear, speaker, close), one with a small lantern-red notification dot; currency pills (brass square-hole coin '2.450', green gem '38') and a green '+120' and red '−20'; a player slot: round portrait avatar in a bamboo ring, name 'Minh' and separate chips for level '12' and '8 lá', a brass-gold timer arc and a small crown; a game card with header 'Tiến Lên', an illustrated body of fanned cards, and a footer of separate chips '4 người', '10 phút' and a green dot with '32'; a panel with honey-wood header, paper body and decorative wave separator; a torn giấy dó toast 'Đã sao chép mã phòng'. Flat even lighting, product sheet presentation. All HUD and buttons sit on dark backgrounds with cream text. Text never joins parts with dots, slashes or bars; parts are separated by space, color and small chips. Rising numbers are green, falling numbers red.
assets.genre-select: The game selection screen for one genre, like the map selection screen of a battle-royale mobile game. Background: a blurred close-up of the 'Bài' card island. Top center: a horizontal row of genre tabs shaped like small wooden island plaques: 'Cờ', 'Bài' (active, glowing gold), 'Tiệc', 'Đối Kháng', 'Sự kiện'. Middle: a horizontal scrolling row of large vertical game cards with rounded wooden frames, each card has a painted illustration on top and a cream paper name plate below: 'Tiến Lên' (card pavilion by the sea, selected, larger, with a gold glowing frame and a check mark), 'Mậu Binh' (three rows of cards on a mat), 'Bài Cào' (three cards and coins on a woven tray), and a fourth card half cut off at the right edge, foggy with a padlock, 'Sắp có'. Each card shows small chips '2–4 người' and a green dot with an online count. Right side of the screen: a narrow detail panel for the selected game on paper inset in a wooden frame: title 'Tiến Lên', a one-line tagline 'Đánh hết bài trước để thắng', chips '4 người' and '12 phòng đang mở', buttons: big lacquered red-gold 'Chọn', wooden 'Tạo phòng', wooden 'Danh sách phòng', and a small scroll icon 'Luật'. Top-left round wooden back-arrow button; top-right xu plaque '2.450' and gear button.
assets.lobby-ring: The main lobby of a polished mobile game, landscape 19.5:9, finished in-game screenshot that a Godot 2D game could really ship: flat cartoon 2.5D art, clean color blocks, soft outlines, short soft shadows, light from the upper left. No central village island and no character. Instead, five genre islands sit evenly on a large tilted circular ring on a clear turquoise sea (#3EC1C9), seen from slightly above like a carousel. The front-center island is the active one: the biggest, fully saturated, softly glowing gold rim on the water around it, with a wooden name plaque 'Bài' above it; it is a sand island with a giant fan of playing cards and a small pavilion. Going around the ring and shrinking with distance, slightly faded: left 'Cờ' (xiangqi board island with big stone pieces), back-left a small festival island with red lanterns, back-right a foggy island with a padlock, right a tiny dock island. Only the active island shows a name plaque. A thin dotted wake line traces the ring on the water. HUD on dark translucent brown backgrounds (#3A2416 at 85%) with cream text, all small and in the corners: top-left a round avatar in a bamboo ring, the name 'Minh' and, as a separate small chip, the level '12'; top-right two separate currency pills (a brass square-hole coin with '2.450', a green gem with '38') and a round dark gear button; bottom-left a row of four small dark icon buttons each with a tiny label under it: 'Nhà', 'Chợ', 'Đình', 'Bến'; right edge middle a small picture banner for 'Trung Thu' with a separate chip '5 ngày'. Bottom-right: a selected-game card with a header strip 'Tiến Lên', a body with a small card-fan thumbnail, and a footer with two separate chips '4 người' and '10 phút' and a green dot with '32'; to its right one big glossy red lacquer button with a brass-gold border reading 'CHƠI', the only lavish element; under the card a smaller deep-teal (#1E8FA6) button 'Tạo phòng' with cream text. Text never joins parts with dots, slashes or bars; parts are separated by space and color. Exact Vietnamese diacritics. No instructional copy, no watermark, no phone frame.
assets.room-list: The harbor screen 'Bến' for joining friends. Background: a softly blurred wooden harbor with moored basket boats (thuyền thúng). Left: a panel with a honey-wood header 'Vào phòng' and a cream paper body with 4 large letter boxes holding 'K7M2' and a deep-teal (#1E8FA6) button 'Vào' with cream text. Right: a taller panel with header 'Phòng đang mở' and a paper body listing 4 rows separated by thin decorative wave lines; each row: a tiny game thumbnail, the game name in bold, the host name as a separate small chip, a seats chip like '3/4' in its own color, and a small deep-teal button 'Vào'. Rows: Tiến Lên with host Lan 3/4, Caro with host Tú 1/2, Cờ Tướng with host Hải 1/2, Tiến Lên with host Hội cuối tuần 2/4. Top-left a small round dark back-arrow button; top-right a dark pill with a coin and '2.450'. All HUD and buttons sit on dark backgrounds with cream text. Text never joins parts with dots, slashes or bars; parts are separated by space, color and small chips. Rising numbers are green, falling numbers red.
